liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Space** (3 reviews): Reviewer calls the space the best part of the show; The space before Not Fade Away is described as groovy [10][14][17]
- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Eyes falls apart into chaos and then outer space; sloppy, and never reaches a big jam; The band starts to burn during Eyes, though the second set is cut short [10][17]
- **Not Fade Away** (2 reviews): Reviewer thinks the Not Fade Away is outstanding; Not Fade Away is slow and very heavy, and the band pounds it most of the way [13][17]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Cassidy is named among the top-notch performances, along with Loser, Deal and Let It Grow [15]
- **Loser** (1 review): Despite Jerry's ragged voice, Loser has a very powerful instrumental break [15]

## Setlist highlights

- **Phil Announcement**: back after 225 archived shows (1627 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-01-14.mtx.holwein.motb-0121.105811.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 154 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1978-01-14.aud.sirmick.88091.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 18 songs; 133 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Hiss and several instances of wow and flutter remain; levels were evened out and bass and mids boosted; Much of the between-song tuning and crowd noise is missing, with transitions smoothed by crossfades [2]
- **gd1978-01-14.aud.unknown.lmpp.99092.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 18 songs; 136 min [3]
- **gd1978-01-14.fob.akgd224e.holwein.motb-0117.105758.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 135 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer hears the January 1978 recording as energized and raw [14]
- **gd78-01-14.sbd.vernon.16114.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 151 min; rated 3.6/5 by 10 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the soundboard mix below average and the band's playing flat; Mix is average with balance off in places, but still listenable; Sound is muddy at times, and Keith's piano is badly distorted in the recording [9][10][13]

## Around the show

- Reviewer, front and center, says Bakersfield police moved on the sound tech for drinking wine, disrupting the show [11]
- Jerry declared the band would never come back to Bakersfield, then finished the show [11]
- Remaining songs were rushed to meet the contract, and the band seemed to lose heart afterward [11]
- Garcia's voice was in bad shape because he was recovering from laryngitis [3]
- The show was cut short because the PA soundman was arrested by Bakersfield police [3]
- Reviewer says many other shows deserve a listen before this one [9]
- Show has the heavy energy of early 1978; reviewer says by April the sound changed and some power was lost [15]
- Reviewer rates the first set slightly above the second, though parts of both are excellent [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-01-14.mtx.holwein.motb-0121.105811.flac16**: transferred by Bob Menke and Derek McCabe; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [1]. Also: This copy is a matrix recording, filed under the name Holwein [1]
- **gd1978-01-14.aud.sirmick.88091.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Uncle Barry; transferred by SirMick; source: aud > ??? > cdr > eac > wav > flac [2]. Also: Audience recording from a fairly high-generation disc source; pitch adjusted to match the circulating soundboard and dropouts repaired [2]
- **gd1978-01-14.aud.unknown.lmpp.99092.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Brion Green and SIRMick; source: Unknown Audience recording, believed to be a 3rd gen cass [3]. Also: Upgrade of the same audience recording as 88091, speed-corrected, with Candyman cut patched from 16114; tapes from Jim Richardson [3]
- **gd1978-01-14.fob.akgd224e.holwein.motb-0117.105758.flac16**: taped by Reinhart Holwein; transferred by Bob Menke and Derek McCabe; source: 2 x AKG D224E >> Sony TC-158SD >> MAC [4]. Also: The tape was recorded and transferred at the correct speed [19]
- **gd78-01-14.sbd.vernon.16114.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1978-01-14 Bakersfield Memorial Auditorium, Bakersfield, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1978-01-14-bakersfield-memorial-auditorium-bakersfield-ca-usa/) [21]
- Poster by Mason's Children: [January Grateful Dead Show Listening Guides](https://www.gratefuldeadbook.com/post/january-grateful-dead-show-reviews) [22]
